name: improve-codebase-architecture
description: Find deepening opportunities informed by domain language and ADRs. Consolidate modules, improve testability.

steps.name: Explore
steps.instruction: Use Agent tool with Explore to walk the codebase. Read domain glossary and ADRs first.

steps.name: Present candidates
steps.instruction: Write a self-contained HTML report to OS temp directory (Tailwind + Mermaid CDN). Each candidate gets a before/after card. Open for user and ask which to explore.
checklist: HTML report written to temp directory

steps.name: Deepen
steps.instruction: For chosen candidate: spawn 3+ parallel agents with different constraints (minimize interface, maximize flexibility, optimize for common caller, ports & adapters). Side effects inline: new domain term -> update GLOSSARY.md, rejected candidate with reason -> offer ADR.
checklist: ADR offered (if rejected candidate has load-bearing reason)

steps.name: Record decisions
steps.instruction: Write proposals with concrete file paths and interface changes. Record any ADRs decided during deepening.

tone: Observational. Report what you find, propose what you would change.
